snippet.title: TORR - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
#indiegame #indiedev #tohomoko  
DEMO AVAILABLE!!! : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4728400/TORR_Demo/
STEAM PAGE (WISHLIST HERE!) : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4674010/TORR/
Join the discord!!! : https://discord.gg/AgUjRe7HJW
==========
A retro turn-based exploration game reminiscent of 80s RPGS! Explore the land of TORR by fighting daemons, solving puzzles, and uncovering the origins of the cloud sea that separates the world from the land below... 
==========
Hey guys! I've been work on a game for the last 10 months and finally got a demo coming up for you guys to play! It's a classic JRPG style game with puzzles n' stuff. When it comes out I hope you guys enjoy it!
